title: Jesus... Why Does My Mind Get Loud The Moment I Lie Down?

bible.text: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you rest, your sleep will be sweet.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why does my mind get loud the moment I lie down? 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: It's 3 AM. I'm replaying everything I said today.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You held it all together all day. At night, it all comes out at once.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I've tried everything. Music, no phone, counting.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You don't have to win against your thoughts tonight. Hand them to Me.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You don't have to stay awake to keep watch. That's My job. Close your eyes.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Save this for the next 3 AM.
